subthemes.name: Planning Which Tools to Use
subthemes.gist: Papers about helping agents decide which tools to call in the right order, like planning a multi-step recipe before you start cooking.

subthemes.name: Teaching Agents to Think and Reason
subthemes.gist: Papers about making agents reason better when using tools — checking their work, thinking before acting, or breaking down problems into smaller pieces.

subthemes.name: Multiple Agents Working Together
subthemes.gist: Papers about coordinating several agents to solve problems together, like a team brainstorming or dividing tasks.

subthemes.name: Learning Through Trial and Error
subthemes.gist: Papers about training agents to get better by trying things, getting feedback, and adjusting their strategy — reinforcement learning for tool use.

subthemes.name: Benchmarks and Agent Testing
subthemes.gist: Papers that create tests and benchmarks to measure how well agents can use tools and accomplish goals.

subthemes.name: Agents Interacting with the Physical World
subthemes.gist: Papers about agents that see and act in the real world or realistic simulations — like robots, autonomous driving, or interacting with computers.

subthemes.name: Remembering and Using Information
subthemes.gist: Papers about helping agents remember important facts and use them later, like keeping notes of what happened and learning from experience.

subthemes.name: Humans and Agents Teaming Up
subthemes.gist: Papers about how humans and AI agents can work together better — like clarifying what the human wants or dividing responsibilities.
